report.lead: Thank you for helping us get it right. Tell us what is wrong and, if you know it, the correct version.
report.url_hint: Filled in if you came from a story; you can change it or paste another link.
report.what_hint: For example: a date, a name, a place, a translation.
report.source_label: A source or link that confirms it (optional)
report.email_hint: Only if you want a reply.
report.privacy: When you send, the message goes to the team by email through the FormSubmit service. We keep nothing else. More at
report.sent_text: Thank you! We will check it and correct it if needed.
report.failed: Could not send right now. Try again or write to us directly at
report.too_short: Describe the mistake in a few words.

viz.test_numbers: Test numbers, invented. Not historical data.
viz.army_scale: Each dot stands for {n} people. Filled dots show the lowest estimate; empty dots, the rest of the range up to the highest estimate.
viz.army_ratio: The group “{big}” has about {x} times as many people as the group “{small}” (comparing the middle of the estimates).
viz.ship_scale: All ships are drawn to the same scale. Sizes in metres.
viz.ship_ratio: “{big}” is about {x} times as long as “{small}”.
